alt_text: Public domain artwork (a painting of a dirt path winding through a wooded park) shown as a bordered print on lavender, with the title The Gloria Tornado and subtitle below. Not Plain.

captions.instagram:
The Gloria Tornado.

I'm six, sitting on a tiny raised seat in the middle of the back row, right next to my little brother's car seat. The road ahead is miles of winding dirt. We're late, of course.

From Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.

#memoir #narrativenonfiction #childhoodmemories #truestory
